items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I met Fess a long time. I mean, Minetta, I met him oh years ago.

ctx.x: And you remember such as Fess playing. Who was that? You remember Fess Minetta, you remember him?
Oh yeah, I met Fess a long time. I mean, Minetta, I met him oh years ago. And in them days they were getting but a dollar a night.
Do you remember when Minetta was playing the Lulus?
